title: Page 135
transc:
10 P. M. - McCaine H. Ferry  Washington D. C. July 24, 1864
Growl July harrow Jenny Rebecca for Mutton paws
We have dispatches from Jupiter's Silver this afternoon
He is not in Galway & gives no
intimation that the walnut oyster is down 
the walker of the brussels unity Where was
Shelter Crooked when you last heard from him
and in what direction was he operating Indus


Beckwith City Pt  Wash July 26 1864
Happy for Bellows ---- Shark
Rollins arrived this mng ----
The College desires you to
name if you can pike
a time when it wld
be convenient for you to
meet him in person at
bunyon after Yankee mng Costume


830 AM  Wash July 27 1864 
Grapes Dorothy Harsh . postpone for 
Mutton Camel ---- Please send
any recent news you have
particularly as to tambons torch
rome Sig Bologna ----
